basis: Viral infection; inflammatory arthritis occurs in 30-79% and can persist. Rash is generally transient; neurologic damage is uncommon.
Inherited trigeminal autonomic headache disorder; tearing, rhinorrhea and ptosis do not indicate separate organ damage.
Juvenile-onset neurodegenerative Parkinson disease; no additional organ damage established across the group.
Respiratory ciliary dysfunction with bronchiectasis; chronic middle-ear dysfunction/otitis is common (2/2 reported). Dextrocardia alone does not impair cardiac function.
Isolated sperm structural and motility defects causing infertility; reproductive function has no axis and endocrine dysfunction is not established.
Isolated sensorineural hearing loss caused by an inherited mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation disorder.
Chronic infection and inflammation of the lacrimal sac, usually associated with nasolacrimal obstruction.
Congenital left ventricular-to-right atrial communication. Endocarditis is a separate infection; edema and crackles do not establish additional organ damage.
Benign adipose neoplasm usually arising in subcutis. Prominent intratumoral vessels do not establish a cardiovascular disorder.
Congenital absence of the gallbladder; the gallbladder belongs to the hepatic axis.
Inherited red-cell destruction causes hemolytic anemia; jaundice and dark urine do not establish liver or urinary tract damage.
Motor-neuron degeneration involving anterior horn cells and corticospinal tracts. Muscle wasting is secondary to denervation, not direct muscle disease.
Open vertebral defect with herniation of spinal cord and meninges. Neurogenic bladder is a separately diagnosed downstream disorder.
Meningeal tumor arising in the epidural spinal canal; neural compression remains within the neurologic axis.
Inherited cardiac conduction disorder with sinus-node dysfunction and frequent atrioventricular block.
Familial mitral valve prolapse with regurgitation. Frequencies and functional significance of accompanying skeletal features are not established.
Inherited early macular degeneration with visual loss; FBN2 alone does not establish systemic connective-tissue disease.
Inherited high myopia; all reported patients have ocular refractive and growth abnormalities.
Immune lymphoproliferative syndrome defined by thrombocytopenia, marrow fibrosis and renal dysfunction. Hepatomegaly and fluid effusions alone do not establish tissue damage.
Malignancy arising in a Meckel diverticulum of the ileum.
Occlusion of a cerebral artery. Brain infarction is a separately diagnosed consequence and is not required by this concept.
Structural, systolic, diastolic and electrical myocardial dysfunction associated with cirrhosis; underlying liver cirrhosis is a separate disease.
Combined immunodeficiency; dermatitis 11/15, esophagitis 5/7 and established bronchiectasis 6/13 support organ damage. Infection risk alone is insufficient.
X-linked neurodevelopmental disorder with intellectual disability in 9/9 and seizures in 3/9; stature and head-shape findings do not establish another damaged organ.
Cerebrovascular ischemic injury causing brain tissue necrosis; both cerebral vascular supply and neural tissue define the disease.
